nodes.description: Contract owner address; receives house fees and controls all onlyOwner administrative functions.
ERC20 token (USDT-like, 6 decimals) used for deposits and payouts; external call target.
Secondary ERC20 token sweepable by the owner via takeRemainingTVOTokens.
Address receiving 3% of every deposit; set in constructor.
Current daily round index used to key the round mapping and pool logic.
Monotonic user id counter written during registration.
Accumulator of missed direct referral commissions; withdrawable by owner.
Accumulator of missed ROI/sponsor-pool commissions; withdrawable by owner.
Running total of deposits, incremented with raw unchecked += arithmetic.
Running total of withdrawals, incremented with raw unchecked += arithmetic.
Mapping address => User struct holding investment, income limits and referral state.
Mapping address => PlayerEarnings holding withdrawableAmount and lockedAmount.
Mapping roundID => DailyRound holding startTime, endTime, ended flag and pool balance.
Mapping user id => address; the referrer lookup table derived from untrusted ids.
Leaderboard[4] of current top sponsors driving pool awards.
Dynamic array of admin addresses each receiving 1% of deposits.
Mapping address => bool granting the higher 30% direct referral rate.
Mapping address => round => PlayerDailyRounds tracking per-round ETH volume.
uint256[4] award split (40/30/20/10) applied to the top sponsor pool.
Leaderboard[4] storing previous round winners and their winning amounts.
Deployment constructor: takes owner from msg.sender, seeds admin player, initializes round 1 with block.timestamp.
Public payable entry point; handles first-time registration and re-investment, performs multiple external token transfers.
Public withdrawal of aggregated earnings; settles income then transfers investToken to msg.sender.
Time-dependent internal settlement of daily ROI based on block.timestamp deltas.
Internal loop distributing ROI matching bonus up to 25 uplines; mutates m2.
Internal direct referral commission distributor (invocation commented out in registerUser).
Internal round transition; compares pool to 10 ether and calls awardTopPromoters.
Internal leaderboard insertion logic mutating topSponsors.
Internal award distribution to the top 4 sponsors using awardPercentage; mutates m2 and leaderboards.
onlyOwner function paying out m1/m2 accumulators to an arbitrary receiver via .transfer.
onlyOwner sweep of all tevvoToken balance to owner.
onlyOwner function pushing an address into admins (cap 5).
onlyOwner function removing an address from admins.
onlyOwner manual trigger of startNextRound.
onlyOwner function granting leader status which raises referral payout rates.
onlyOwner external entry delegating to _transferOwnership.
Internal ownership reassignment with zero-address check.
Caller-controlled address used as identity, owner and transfer destination.
Block timestamp (now) driving round scheduling and daily ROI settlement.
External ERC20 pull of deposit funds from the caller into the contract.
External ERC20 push of fees and payouts to owner/admins/refundAllocation/withdrawer.
Low-gas native ETH .transfer to an owner-supplied receiver inside withdrawAdminFees.
External ERC20 transfer of the entire tevvoToken balance to owner.
Caller-supplied upline id used to index userList.
Deposit amount derived from msg.value and reused for fee and pool math.
Resolved referrer address taken from the userList mapping.
Aggregated withdrawable earnings sum across four income buckets.
Account whose daily ROI is settled.
Requested payout amount for admin fee withdrawal.
Caller-chosen destination of the native ETH transfer.
Selector choosing whether m1 or m2 is drained.
Upline address walked in the 25-level referral loop.
Residual amount tracked while distributing the ROI matching bonus.
Address granted leader status by the owner.
New owner address supplied to transferOwnership.
Address added to the admins array.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the deploying caller becomes the privileged account.
msg.sender is used as the player identity that is registered, credited and debited.
msg.sender determines which earnings are settled and where investToken is sent.
now is written to lastSettledTime and compared against round endTime to branch the flow.
Round-expiry check using now can trigger startNextRound from the withdrawal path.
Daily ROI payout is entirely conditioned on block.timestamp deltas.
Round start/end timestamps are derived from now, making pool timing miner-influenced.
Constructor writes the owner state variable from the untrusted caller.
Constructor wires the investToken ERC20 used for all fund movements.
Constructor seeds round[1] startTime/endTime from the block timestamp.
Constructor initializes roundID to 1.
Registration and re-investment write investment, income-limit and referrer fields; limits arise from mul/div math.
Deposit credits withdrawableAmount/lockedAmount in playerEarnings.
currUserID is incremented on every new registration and bounds the referrer id check.
userList is read for the referrer lookup and written with the new user id.
totalDeposit uses raw unchecked += which can wrap.
Deposit path performs an external ERC20 safeTransferFrom against a caller-influenced token.
Deposit path performs external safeTransfer calls to owner, every admin and refundAllocation.
3% of each deposit is routed to refundAllocation.
Referral branch calls addSponsorToPool for the resolved referrer.
Expired round detection inside registration triggers startNextRound.
The external token contract regains control during safeTransferFrom and may re-enter registerUser.
The external token contract regains control during safeTransfer and may re-enter registerUser.
addSponsorToPool reads and rewrites the topSponsors leaderboard.
Leaderboard ranking decisions are based on plyrRnds_ per-round ETH volume.
startNextRound calls awardTopPromoters when the pool reaches 10 ether.
Sponsor awards credit incomeLimitLeft and sponsorPoolIncome; remainder tracking uses mul/div.
Award amounts are derived from awardPercentage applied to the pool.
awardTopPromoters copies and then zeroes the topSponsors entries.
Previous winners are persisted into lastTopSponsors and lastTopSponsorsWinningAmount.
Missed sponsor awards are accumulated in m2.
withdrawEarnings always calls settleIncome first to realize pending daily ROI.
Earnings are aggregated from player income buckets and then zeroed after payout.
withdrawableAmount is decremented or converted into lockedAmount using raw -= / +=
totalWithdrawn uses raw unchecked += which can wrap.
Payout performs an external safeTransfer of investToken to msg.sender.
The token contract regains control during the payout transfer, enabling re-entry without a guard.
Contract token balance is queried to ensure solvency before paying out.
Withdrawal path can also advance the round when the timer expired.
settleIncome forwards the realized daily income to roiReferralBonus.
Daily income, incomeLimitLeft and lastSettledTime are recomputed from timestamp deltas.
Settlement arithmetic depends directly on the miner-influenceable block timestamp.
Up to 25 uplines have incomeLimitLeft and roiReferralIncome rewritten in a loop.
Unpaid matching bonuses are recorded into m2.
Direct referral commission adjusts incomeLimitLeft and directsIncome of the upline.
Missed direct commissions are recorded into m1.
onlyOwner gate protects accumulation withdrawal and arbitrary receiver payout.
onlyOwner gate allows sweeping the full tevvoToken balance.
onlyOwner gate allows adding privileged fee-receiving admins.
onlyOwner gate allows removing admins.
onlyOwner gate allows manual round advancement and pool redistribution.
onlyOwner gate allows granting leader status that changes payout rates.
onlyOwner gate protects ownership transfer entry point.
m1 is decremented by the requested amount before payout.
m2 is decremented by the requested amount before payout.
Native ETH is pushed to a caller-supplied receiver address via .transfer.
The receiver regains control on the ETH transfer and may re-enter privileged payout logic.
transferOwnership delegates the privileged state change to the internal helper.
_transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with the supplied address.
addLeader flips isLeader, which raises referral payouts from 20% to 30%.
addAdmin pushes into the admins array that drains 1% of every deposit.
removeAdmin mutates the admins array via swap-and-pop.
Owner sweep triggers an external tevvoToken transfer of the full balance.
Balance of the tevvoToken contract is read before sweeping to owner.
drawPool simply forwards execution to startNextRound.
roundID is incremented when the pool threshold is met.
Round pool is reduced by distributed awards and start/end times are rewritten.

normalization_plan.reason: Transient input only used to index userList inside registerUser.
Local deposit amount whose full lifetime is contained in registerUser.
Locally resolved referrer address consumed only by registerUser.
Aggregated earnings sum computed and consumed exclusively in withdrawEarnings.
Settlement target used only as an index into player within settleIncome.
Requested payout amount consumed only inside the admin fee withdrawal.
Directly supplies the destination of the native ETH transfer unsafe operation.
Branch selector that chooses between draining m1 and m2.
Loop cursor over uplines that exists only inside roiReferralBonus.
Residual bookkeeping variable fully scoped to roiReferralBonus.
Address written into isLeader only by addLeader.
New owner value consumed by the internal ownership setter.
Address appended to the admins array inside addAdmin.
